catatan: Lanjutan pilihan CLIMB THROUGH THE HATCH: memanjat lubang lift ke lantai 20. Fiksi orisinal, bahasa Inggris USA.

baris.text: Okay. Don't look down. Just climb.
baris.arah: (scared and determined, breathing hard while climbing, shaky voice)

baris.text: Floor twenty. I can make it.
baris.arah: (breathless, trying to stay brave, quiet hope)
(calm polite automated elevator voice, slow, eerie and too close)

baris.text: You forgot to hold the door.
baris.arah: (creepy calm girl whisper, slow, cold and smiling, sinister)
(panicked screaming, frantic, climbing fast, out of breath)
(creepy slow whisper, eerie and cold, unnaturally calm, sinister)

noob.desain: (young American teenage boy gamer, about seventeen, casual natural voice, relaxed and a little sarcastic)
noob.ref_teks: Man, this hotel is so quiet tonight. Nobody is in the lobby, and my room is all the way at the top.

lily.desain: (young American girl, about fourteen, soft sweet voice, a little breathy)
lily.ref_teks: I lost my friends somewhere in this hotel, and now I can't remember which floor my room is on.

lift.desain: (calm American female automated elevator voice, clear, polite and robotic)
lift.ref_teks: Welcome to Blocky Inn. Doors closing. Please stand clear of the doors and enjoy your stay.
